psfDefinition: STScI standard SM4 empirical F606W PSF, bilinear detector-grid interpolation, no fitted focus
sources: Same frozen source peaks and quality estimator as baseline. Compare both techniques on a common intersection and report each gate rejection.
partitions: Even 512-pixel source tiles for fitting, odd tiles for final spatial holdout. Tile assignment fixed from the source peak coordinates.
precondition: Exposures selected by public headerlets and detector separation, before viewing pixel data.
domain: New detector region and different observation epoch. Affine geometry and strict DQ thresholds unchanged.
